tool_args.rationale: The observed sink-gradient dependence and concavity are consistent with several archived mechanisms. The lower-cost open-branch probe can distinguish competing branches before committing to a numerical fit.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon, cooperative Hill, or barrier-modulated siphon directly
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five pilot observations leave limited discrimination among these nonlinear sink-dependent mechanisms and the open branch terms.
The pilot signatures favor a static sink-dependent mechanism; a trajectory batch is more costly and not yet justified.
It is irrelevant to the mechanism ambiguity.
